name: Papertrade
rootCause: Papertrade, a synthetic perpetuals platform with up to 1000x leverage built on Hyperliquid’s HyperEVM, suffered a ~$1.28 million loss about 8 hours after its Oct. 10, 2026 launch. A wallet moved ETH prices on Hyperliquid (via large buys/sells) while holding highly leveraged positions on Papertrade that settled against the manipulated BBO midpoint, extracting profits from the platform’s shared USDC liquidity pool. Papertrade attributed it to overly permissive open-interest limits at launch and tightened them.
